question: The _____________ part in a frost-free refrigerator provides pumping action to the refrigerant.
solution:
The correct answer is __compressor****.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Compressor__ is a crucial part of the frost-free refrigerator.
 
• The compressor provides the pumping action to the refrigerant.
 
• It compresses the refrigerant gas and sends it to the condenser.
 
• The compressor ensures that the refrigerant flows through the cooling system efficiently.
 
• It plays a critical role in maintaining the cooling cycle of the refrigerator.
 
• Without a functional compressor, the refrigerator cannot maintain the desired cooling.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Condenser:**
 
 
• The condenser helps in transforming the refrigerant gas into liquid form.
 
• It dissipates heat from the refrigerant to the surroundings.
 
 
 
• **Capillary Tube:**
 
 
• The capillary tube acts as an expansion device in the refrigeration system.
 
• It reduces the pressure of the refrigerant before it enters the evaporator.
 
 
 
• **Receiver:**
 
 
• The receiver stores the liquid refrigerant coming from the condenser.
 
• It ensures the refrigerant is supplied in the required quantity to the evaporator.
